headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 9, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the offense and Gage Jump earning the win on the mound. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 8 batters.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson, who was placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners, Minnesota Twins, Cleveland Guardians, Chicago White Sox, and Toronto Blue Jays have also made injury-related roster moves.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the acquisition of first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the offense with a home run and an RBI. On the mound, Gage Jump earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, striking out 11 batters.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Ben Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's injury will require a period of recovery before he can return to the field.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that brings new depth to the team's infield.
